title: Prefilled engine inventory, appearance and dirty settings
steps: Inspect dark theme, black orientation and engine profiles A/B/unavailable.
Edit/apply/reset appearance and verify changes without restart.
Rename/remove/add an engine, apply, then open Custom New Game or Change Player and check the inventory.
Leave an unsaved settings edit through Back to game, Cancel and browser Back; choose Keep editing or Discard changes. Apply stays; Save commits and returns.
Check System theme against host changes and the visible 75%/150% scale bounds.
Change session restore, autosave and save folder policies; old saves remain in their original folder.
